photos.desc: An illustration from British Entomology by John Curtis. Sesia bombyliformis or Hemaris tityus ( Narrow-bordered Bee Hawk). The plant is Succisa pratensis ( Scabiosa succisa , Devil’s-bit Scabious)
This photo was taken by M. Nazelrod a Wayne National Forest PhotoNaturalist volunteer. Rutherford Wetland, Athens Ranger District.
